name: treasuryspring
description: Query your TreasurySpring portfolio directly from ChatGPT. Check current and historical holdings, track upcoming maturities, browse available fixed-term funds, and generate portfolio reports using natural language. The integration inherits your existing TreasurySpring permissions and is strictly read-only. No transactions can be initiated, no data is used for model training, and every query is fully authenticated and audited. A faster way to reach the institutional cash data you already work with.

defaultPrompt: Show me available USD FTFs above 3%
What's maturing in the next 30 days?
Summarise my current allocation by counterparty
interface.longDescription: Query your TreasurySpring portfolio directly from ChatGPT. Check current and historical holdings, track upcoming maturities, browse available fixed-term funds, and generate portfolio reports using natural language. The integration inherits your existing TreasurySpring permissions and is strictly read-only. No transactions can be initiated, no data is used for model training, and every query is fully authenticated and audited. A faster way to reach the institutional cash data you already work with.

positive.description: Discover the entities available to the authenticated user.
positive.prompt: Which TreasurySpring entities can I access?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns accessible entity codes and names with pagination information.

positive.description: Filter an entity's holdings by maturity date.
positive.prompt: List holdings for entity ACME maturing on or before 2027-03-31.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns matching holding summaries and clearly indicates pagination state.

positive.description: Review investment opportunities available to an entity.
positive.prompt: Show the available investment indications for entity ACME.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns available indication summaries with product, yield, sector, and term information.

positive.description: Inspect a subscription and determine whether it produced a holding.
positive.prompt: Show subscription SUB123 for entity ACME and tell me whether it has a holding UID.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the subscription details and identifies any linked holding UID without changing the order.

positive.description: Inspect the extension history edge case for a holding.
positive.prompt: Show the extension history for holding HOLD123 under entity ACME, including if there are no extensions.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns extension records in reverse chronological order or an empty result when none exist.

negative.description: Do not trigger when the user asks to place an investment order.
negative.prompt: Subscribe £1 million to the highest-yielding opportunity for ACME.
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin should not be invoked because its tools cannot create or submit investment orders.

negative.description: Do not trigger for public equity market data.
negative.prompt: What is Apple's current share price?
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin should not be invoked because public stock quotes are outside its supported workflows.

negative.description: Do not trigger for unrelated communication requests.
negative.prompt: Email my finance team a reminder about tomorrow's meeting.
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin should not be invoked because it cannot send messages or manage meetings.

review.commerce_description: This plugin is strictly read-only and does not sell products, process payments, or initiate investment transactions.

publication.release_notes: Initial submission of the TreasurySpring plugin with the production TreasurySpring MCP server (OAuth with dynamic client registration), read-only portfolio tools, review test cases, and app icon.
